ai/npc/KetraOrcSupport/31374-01.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Jaff: Yo, comrade of Ketra! Welcome! This warehouse is where our war supplies are stored! I know you've worked hard, but I can't yet open the warehouse to a foreigner such as yourself! Keep up the good work! One day our chief will allow you to use the warehouse!

ai/npc/KetraOrcSupport/31374-02.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Jaff: Come here, friend of Ketra! You've been given permission to use our warehouse by our chief! A valued warrior like you shouldn't have to carry around a heavy load! Leave anything here you don't need for combat!

ai/npc/KetraOrcSupport/31374-no.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Jaff: Go away! This warehouse is reserved for the glorious warriors of Ketra! It's not for outsiders!
